reviews.text: Had n AC condensation pipe clog that was causing a leak in the drain pipe. Isaura contacted me through my post on Nextdoor to connect me with my repair guy. Mordechai Meir Did a great job in coming out and fixing the issue as quick as possible. Service was friendly and scheduling was flexible. Pricing was slightly higher than what I was expecting.
reviews.owner_response: Varden, glad our team could resolve your AC condensation issue without delay and that the scheduling worked well for you. We appreciate you mentioning the friendly service and thank you for your honest feedback about the pricing. Your detailed review helps us continue to improve at Aire Serv of Central and North Austin. Thank you for choosing us!

reviews.text: I recently had a summer checkup from Aire Serv if Central and North Austin.  I was a long time customer but stopped a few years back when new owners bought the service area that I was in.  It was not the same service that I was accustomed to.  For a few years I tried different service providers and none of these providers had the customer service I was searching for.  Yesterday, I received a text from the new owner of AireServ in my area. They offered to come service my AC unit for the summer. I had been stressing about finding a new provider. I immediately jumped at the opportunity to give the new owners an opportunity to gain my trust.  I was please with their service.  I look forward to establishing a new relationship with the new owners.

We’ve used AirServe for a few years now and are extremely satisfied with their honesty, promptness, and professionalism.   Strongly recommend!

UPDATE:  THEY STOPPED RETURNING CALLS IN EARLY MAY 2026.  TECH LEFT.  NO ONE HAS RESPONDED FOR 3 DAYS

Haider was great.  We called early today, they were very busy and still made time for us.  This is the 2nd time that we have used their services and the price is always reasonable.   They are doing quality and honest work.
reviews.owner_response:
Nick, thank you for trusting us to be a heating and cooling company you can count on! Haider was happy to help you on the same day you called, so that you could feel just right in your space. We look forward to serving you again!
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: haider and his team did a great job of delivering exactly what i needed for this project. installation was quick and done right.
reviews.owner_response:
We’re grateful for the opportunity to complete your HVAC installation the right way, J. Thanks for your trust and for sharing your experience.
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: I called AireServ after a different company said I have to buy a new AC system for a low price of 13k.  They said it could not be repaired.  The unit is only about 5 years old.  AireServ came promptly and fixed the AC system. The technician said it’s pretty new, it doesn’t need changing.  He figured out what was wrong and fixed it.  I’m very grateful for the money they saved me.
reviews.owner_response:
Belinda, we're overjoyed to hear about the excellent service you received and the money we were able to save you! It's great to know that our service professional was able to promptly diagnose and fix your AC system, especially when you were told by another company that it couldn't be repaired. We're glad that we could provide you with a cost-effective solution and save your relatively new unit from being unnecessarily replaced. Until next time, thank you! 
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: I needed emergency service on a Sunday and Haider pulled up a the house within an hour with a acceptable diagnostic fee for coming out on a Sunday. Great service and customer experience.
reviews.owner_response:
Brent, your kind words and perfect rating have us grinning from ear to ear! It's fantastic to hear that Haider was able to assist you promptly on a Sunday and that you found our diagnostic fee to be fair. We're delighted that you had a positive customer experience with our service. Thank you for your continued support and for choosing us for your HVAC needs!
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: Returning customer, had to track them down. Called, downloaded the app, call day time, call after hours. Final connected directly with service person and night before told me the machine broke. I called a competitor and then were able to book a next day meeting.
reviews.owner_response:
Austin, we appreciate your feedback and want to apologize for your experience. When you initially gave us a call to schedule a duct cleaning and UV light installation appointment, we immediately called you back same day and left a voicemail. When you returned our call, we were happy to get you scheduled for an estimate the following day. Unfortunately, after contacting our duct cleaning team to confirm your appointment, we found that the machine had broken down that day. We promptly called you to inform you about this issue and to let you know that it may take up to two weeks for the machine to be repaired, but that we were looking forward to providing you with our services. We would have been more than happy to come out to perform this service, but we understand you were looking for an immediate appointment. We hope you'll give us another chance to earn your trust down the road.
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: I had a very good experience. The technician was knowledgeable and found my problem quickly. He had it running same day but had to order a part. The part arrived quickly.  It worked at first and then quit. Tech was back (almost) immediately and discovered and fixed the new problem. Very responsive, and I will continue to use their service. Highly recommended.
Obvious expertise. Great service. And Perfect installation.  By far, the best value as well. Highly highly recommended.
reviews.owner_response:
Thank you for sharing your experience, Nick! We're proud to be a heating and cooling company you can trust.
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: Haider gave me a great deal on the installation of a mini split in my garage. The install was seamless and the system works great. Highly recommend!
reviews.owner_response:
Thank you for your recommendation, Daniel. We're delighted to hear that Haider's seamless installation was valuable to you. It was a pleasure assisting you and we hope you breathe easy knowing Aire Serv is on your side! 
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: Great company to work with.  They were very responsive.  They completed work in a timely manner.  I will definitely use them again and will also recommend them to others.
reviews.owner_response:
Thank you for your recommendation, Tommie! We're proud to be a heating and cooling company you can count on and look forward to helping you again in the future.
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: Same day service when my a/c went out in the middle of summer! No other company was able to respond as quickly and Air Serv saved the day! Really quick service too!
reviews.owner_response:
Thank you for your review, Anyssa! We're glad we could provide same-day service and get your A/C up and running again. It's our pleasure to provide efficient and professional HVAC repair! 
The Aire Serv Team

We truly appreciate your recommendation! Our team is dedicated to providing top-notch, affordable service, and it's rewarding to hear that we're succeeding. Thank you for your kind words!
The Aire Serv Team

That's exactly what we like to hear, Lazaros. Thank you for sharing your experience!
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: We used Aire Serv to replace both upstairs and downstairs heating and cooling systems- interior and exterior units… The whole kit. Working with these guys was fantastic and affordable. Highly recommended them!
reviews.owner_response:
Luke, recommendations like this mean the world to our team! We always strive for excellent and affordable service, and it's great to hear that we're hitting the mark. Thank you for your kind words!
The Aire Serv Team

reviews.text: Haider was super-professional, diagnosed & fixed our problem within 30 minutes. Aire Serve is our new go-to. Thank you!
reviews.owner_response:
Thank you for sharing your recognition of Haider, Jigga! We're proud to have such excellent service professionals on our team. It's great to hear that he got your AC working so quickly so you can stay comfortable in your home, and we look forward to providing equally great service in the future.
The Aire Serv Team

   KNOWLEDGE is the business's own information on file. When a caller asks about something listed there, including a price, state it exactly as written.
